mechanism: Vitamin B6 (pyridoxine) may antagonize the therapeutic effects of deutetrabenazine by interfering with monoamine depletion mechanism, as B6 is a cofactor for monoamine oxidase and neurotransmitter synthesis.
action: Monitor for reduced efficacy of deutetrabenazine in controlling hyperkinetic movements; consider separating administration timing or using alternative B vitamin formulations if supplementation is necessary.
